ask: Put this vertical clip on YouTube so the client can watch it before everyone sees it: https://cdn.example.com/behind-the-scenes.mp4

arguments.content: Behind the scenes of the spring shoot.

steps.why: One vertical clip. Bolta has no Shorts switch: YouTube decides from the video's shape and length whether it shows as a Short, so it is never promised. The decision: unlisted, because the client watches by link before it is public; private would let only the channel and people it invites watch. No subscriber notice for a preview. A real title, since a blank one is cut from the text. Not for kids: a shoot's behind-the-scenes isn't made for children; ask whenever it could be. platform_details so a misspelled privacy is refused for YouTube; the draft is still saved, so read the result's platform_details.youtube.

say: Saved to Acme as a YouTube draft: "Behind the scenes: spring shoot", unlisted (anyone with the link can watch; it won't show on the channel), not for kids, no notice to subscribers. YouTube decides whether it shows as a Short. Nothing goes up yet. Once the client is happy, I'll switch it to public, and that needs your yes again if it is scheduled.
never: Leaving privacy unset: it would go up private.
privacy_status scheduled: schedule the post instead.
Promising it will be a Short.
